image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of an African crocodile's head partially submerged in water. The image highlights the textured, armored skin (scutes), a closed eye with visible eyelid structure, and the upper jawline with several large, conical teeth protruding downwards. The lower jaw is mostly submerged or obscured by the angle, but the interlocking nature of the teeth is suggested. The water surface shows slight ripples and reflections.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the snout tapers to a point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator. The head structure appears broad and robust.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Several large, conical teeth are clearly visible along the upper jawline. They appear to fit into notches or spaces in the lower jaw, consistent with the interlocking description. The fourth tooth prominence is hard to verify exactly due to the angle, but the general tooth structure is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is closed in the image. While the dorsal positioning is evident from the bump on top of the head, the pupil shape and nictitating membrane cannot be verified because the eye is shut.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The very tip of the snout where the nostrils would be located is either out of frame or obscured by the angle and water line. They are not clearly visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible neck and shoulder region show thick, armored plating consistent with an elongated, heavily armored body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly displays raised, bony scutes. While the full longitudinal row pattern isn't entirely visible due to the close crop, the local arrangement and texture match the description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of greys and browns, and the texture is visibly rough and detailed, matching the ground truth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral (belly) surface is not visible in this side-profile head shot; only the dorsal and lateral aspects are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in this close-up head shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.
